rules.statement: An action for the recovery of the balance purchase money of a steam launch sold and delivered cannot be maintained unless brought within one year of such sale and delivery.
rules.supporting_quote: "It may be that 'goods' would not include a British ship, the property in which cannot be transferred by mere sale and delivery, but it is unnecessary to decide this, for in the present case there is no proof that this launch is a British ship. The Master Attendant, with whom this launch is said to have been registered, is not the Registrar of British Ships. That being so this action is not maintainable, for it was not brought within one year after the debt became due."
